treatment_summary.value: Empiric anti-tuberculosis treatment (isoniazid/rifampicin/pyrazinamide/moxifloxacin); prednisolone 2 mg/kg/d weaning to 0.5 mg/kg/d over 6 months plus mycophenolate mofetil 1200 mg/m2/d (no response); intravenous cyclophosphamide (6 doses, 500-750 mg/m2) with prednisolone at 2 mg/kg/d (poor response; steroid side effects); then baricitinib 6 mg/d (JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor, compassionate use) with rapid clinical and radiologic improvement, stable 24 months later with no further seizures; prednisolone weaned off; interferon-induced gene expression normalized.

parental_testing_statement.value: Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous c.A1939C (NM_001270508) p.T647P variant in TNFAIP3, which was confirmed by using Sanger sequencing in subject III.1 and also present in the symptomatic sibling (subject III.2) and mildly symptomatic mother (subject II.2; Fig 1, A and K). Pedigree shows segregation of the p.T647P TNFAIP3 variant.

functional_evidence_statement.value: Heterozygotes for p.T647P (patients' lymphocytes) showed increased phosphorylated NF-kB p65 vs controls (P = .0124); increased proinflammatory cytokines in heterozygotes vs healthy controls: IL-1b, IL-6, IL-8, TNF-a (each P = .02); enhanced phosphorylated IRF3 in lymphocytes from all heterozygotes (P = .0007); increased STAT1 and STAT3 in lymphocytes from p.T647P heterozygotes. Variant lies in the fourth zinc finger domain of A20. Subject III.1 specifically: increased phosphorylated p65 in HDFCs (P = .0001); TNF-stimulated HDFCs showed increased abundance/molecular weight of Lys63-ubiquitinated NEMO (insufficient A20 deubiquitinase activity); PBMCs showed constitutive NLRP3 inflammasome activation with caspase-1 activation (P = .009) and increased IL-1b (P = .007) and IL-18 (P = .01) secretion; upregulated type 1 interferon-stimulated gene expression in whole blood and increased serum IFN-a and IFN-b (P = .04, P = .049); increased phosphorylated IRF3 in HDFCs (P = .009); increased phosphorylated STAT1 and STAT3 in lymphocytes (P = .0001 each) and HDFCs; impaired binding of p.T647P A20 to TBK1 in response to TNF-a in fibroblasts (coimmunoprecipitation).
